explanation.heading: LESSON OBJECTIVE
explanation.text: Recognize corresponding angle pairs formed by a transversal and use their equality when two lines are parallel. Solve angle equations and justify when the converse proves parallelism.

explanation.heading: WHAT YOU NEED TO KNOW
explanation.text: A transversal crosses two lines at different points. At each crossing, four angles occupy upper-left, upper-right, lower-left, and lower-right positions. Corresponding angles occupy the same relative position at the two crossings.

explanation.heading: KEY DEFINITIONS
explanation.text: Parallel lines never meet in the plane. A transversal intersects both lines. Corresponding angles are in matching corners of the two intersections. A linear pair consists of adjacent angles forming a straight 180° angle.

explanation.heading: CORE RULE
explanation.text: When two parallel lines are cut by a transversal, corresponding angles are congruent: m∠1=m∠5, m∠2=m∠6, m∠3=m∠7, m∠4=m∠8 for consistently labeled matching corners. Conversely, equal corresponding angles imply the lines are parallel.

explanation.heading: HOW IT WORKS
explanation.text: Step 1: Confirm the lines are stated or marked parallel. Step 2: Find the same corner at each intersection. Step 3: Set corresponding angle expressions equal. Step 4: Solve and substitute. Step 5: Use 180° only for an adjacent linear pair, not for corresponding angles themselves.

explanation.heading: WORKED EXAMPLE 1 — MATCHING CORNERS
explanation.text: The upper-right angle at the first intersection is 64°. The upper-right angle at the second intersection is also 64° because these are corresponding angles between parallel lines.

explanation.heading: WORKED EXAMPLE 2 — SOLVE AN EQUATION
explanation.text: Corresponding angles are x+18 degrees and 73 degrees. Set x+18=73, so x=55. Substitute: 55+18=73 degrees.

explanation.heading: WORKED EXAMPLE 3 — EXPRESSIONS ON BOTH SIDES
explanation.text: Two corresponding angles measure 3x+5 and 2x+25 degrees. Equality gives 3x+5=2x+25, hence x=20; both angles are 65 degrees.

explanation.heading: WORKED EXAMPLE 4 — ADJACENT THEN CORRESPONDING
explanation.text: One obtuse angle is 128°. Its adjacent acute angle is 180−128=52°. The corresponding acute angle at the second intersection is 52°, not 128°.

explanation.heading: WORKED EXAMPLE 5 — CONVERSE
explanation.text: Two lines crossed by the same transversal have equal upper-left angles of 72° at their intersections. Because a corresponding pair is equal, the converse theorem proves the lines are parallel.

explanation.heading: DETERMINISTIC DIAGRAM
explanation.text: The diagram plots y=0 and y=4 (parallel horizontal lines) and y=x+1 (transversal). Their intersections are (−1,0) and (3,4). The transversal forms acute 45° and obtuse 135° angles with each horizontal line, so matching corners are equal.

explanation.heading: WHEN LINES ARE NOT PARALLEL
explanation.text: Corresponding angles still describe matching positions, but equality is not guaranteed without parallelism. If a corresponding pair is shown equal, the converse can establish that the lines are parallel.

explanation.heading: COMMON MISTAKES
explanation.text: Do not confuse corresponding angles (equal) with same-side interior angles (supplementary). Do not use 180° for two corresponding angles. Do not assume equal angles merely because a transversal crosses two lines with no parallel condition.

explanation.heading: EXAM STRATEGY
explanation.text: Mark one corner at each crossing and follow the transversal to the matching corner. Use equality first, then a straight-angle subtraction if the target angle is adjacent. In algebra questions, substitute the solved x to check the angle remains between 0° and 180°.

explanation.heading: QUICK CHECK
explanation.text: If matching upper-left angles are 39° and 39°, they are corresponding and equal. If corresponding angles are x+22° and 80°, x=58. If one angle is 121°, its adjacent angle is 59°. Attempt these before revealing the reasoning.

explanation.heading: LESSON RECAP / NEXT STEP
explanation.text: Corresponding means same relative position. Parallel lines make corresponding angles equal; equal corresponding angles prove parallel lines. A linear pair totals 180°. Now complete 18 practice questions, review 18 aligned solutions, take the five-question test, and study the full English or Arabic lesson.

practice.question: At two intersections of a transversal, an upper-right angle at each intersection forms what type of angle pair?
practice.solution: Both angles occupy the same upper-right relative position at their crossings.

practice.question: Two lines are parallel. An upper-left angle at the first intersection is 68°. What is its corresponding angle at the second intersection?
practice.solution: Corresponding angles formed by parallel lines are congruent, so the matching angle is 68°.

practice.question: Parallel lines have a corresponding pair with one angle measuring 122°. Find the other.
practice.solution: Corresponding angles are equal when the lines are parallel.

practice.question: Corresponding angles measure (x+18)° and 73°. Find x.
Corresponding angles measure (3x+5)° and (2x+25)°. Find x.
practice.solution: Set 3x+5=2x+25, subtract 2x and 5 to obtain x=20. Both angles then equal 65°.

practice.question: Corresponding angles measure (2x+17)° and (5x−19)°. Find x.
practice.solution: 2x+17=5x−19 gives 36=3x, so x=12. Both angles are 41°.

practice.question: One angle at a crossing is 47°. Find the angle corresponding to its adjacent linear-pair angle at the other crossing, given parallel lines.
practice.solution: The adjacent angle is 180−47=133°. Its corresponding angle is also 133°.

practice.question: One obtuse angle is 128°. Find the angle corresponding to its adjacent acute angle at the second crossing of parallel lines.
practice.solution: The adjacent angle is 180−128=52°, and its corresponding angle remains 52°.

practice.question: Two corresponding angles measure (4x−9)° and (2x+25)°. Find x.
practice.solution: 4x−9=2x+25 implies 2x=34 and x=17; both angles measure 59°.

practice.question: Two corresponding angles measure (x+31)° and (3x−15)°. Find x.
practice.solution: x+31=3x−15 gives 46=2x, so x=23. Both angles measure 54°.

practice.question: Corresponding angles measure (2x+15)° and (x+75)°. Find their common angle measure.
practice.solution: 2x+15=x+75 gives x=60, so each corresponding angle is 2(60)+15=135°.

practice.question: In a diagram of parallel lines, two corresponding angles are (7x−4)° and (3x+52)°. Find x and their measure.
practice.solution: 7x−4=3x+52 gives 4x=56 and x=14; each angle is 7(14)−4=94°.

practice.question: An obtuse angle is 135° at the first crossing. Find the corresponding angle of its adjacent acute angle at the second crossing.
practice.solution: The adjacent acute angle is 180−135=45°, and the matching corner at the second crossing is also 45°.

practice.question: An acute angle is (x+12)°. Its corresponding angle at the other crossing is adjacent to an obtuse angle of (4x+8)°. Find x.
practice.solution: Corresponding acute angles are equal, so the acute and adjacent obtuse expressions sum to 180: (x+12)+(4x+8)=180; 5x=160; x=32. The angles are 44° and 136°.

practice.question: Corresponding angles measure (5x−10)° and (3x+22)°. Find x and the angle measure.
practice.solution: 5x−10=3x+22 gives 2x=32, x=16. Substitution yields 70° in both positions.

practice.question: A transversal makes two upper-right angles of 72° and 72° with two lines. What conclusion follows about the lines?
practice.solution: Equal corresponding angles imply the two lines are parallel by the converse of the corresponding angles theorem.

practice.question: Three parallel lines are cut by the same transversal. Corresponding angles on the top and bottom lines measure (5x+20)° and (8x−25)°. Find x and the common measure.
practice.solution: Because all three lines are parallel, matching angles are equal: 5x+20=8x−25. Thus 3x=45, x=15, and each angle is 95°.

practice.question: At two crossings of parallel lines, corresponding angles a=(2x+18)° and b=(4x−36)°. Angle c is adjacent to b on a straight line. Find x and c.
practice.solution: Set 2x+18=4x−36, so 2x=54 and x=27. Then b=72° and its linear-pair angle c=180−72=108°.

test.question: Parallel lines form a corresponding pair. One angle is 39°. What is the other?
test.solution: Corresponding angles are equal, so the matching angle is 39°.

test.question: Corresponding angles are (x+22)° and 80°. Find x.
Corresponding angles measure (4x+7)° and (3x+26)°. Find x.
An acute angle is (3x+6)°. An adjacent angle to its corresponding angle is (5x+14)°. Find x.
test.solution: The corresponding acute angle equals 3x+6. It and the adjacent angle form 180°: 3x+6+5x+14=180, so x=20.

test.question: Two corresponding angles measure (7x−5)° and (4x+49)°. Find the measure of an angle adjacent to either one.
test.solution: 7x−5=4x+49 gives x=18, so the corresponding angles are 121°. Their adjacent linear-pair angles measure 180−121=59°.

arabic.title: الهدف
arabic.narration: هنتعرف على الزوايا المتناظرة، ونستخدم تساويها لما المستقيمين يكونوا متوازيين، ونحل المعادلات المرتبطة بيها.

arabic.title: فكرة القاطع
arabic.narration: القاطع بيقطع مستقيمين في نقطتين، وعند كل تقاطع أربع زوايا. الزاويتين اللي في نفس الركن النسبي متناظرتان.

arabic.title: تعريف الزوايا
arabic.narration: لو الزاوية أعلى يسار عند التقاطع الأول، فالمتناظرة معاها أعلى يسار عند التقاطع التاني.

arabic.title: القاعدة الأساسية
arabic.narration: لما المستقيمين متوازيين، كل زاويتين متناظرتين متساويتين في القياس.

arabic.title: خطوات الحل
arabic.narration: اتأكد من التوازي، وحدد الركنين المتناظرين، وساوي التعبيرين، وحل المعادلة وراجع الناتج.

arabic.title: مثال مباشر
arabic.narration: لو زاوية متناظرة قياسها أربعة وستين درجة، فالزاوية اللي بتناظرها قياسها أربعة وستين درجة.

arabic.title: مثال جبري
arabic.narration: لو الزاويتين المتناظرتين إكس زائد تمنتاشر وتلاتة وسبعين، يبقى إكس تساوي خمسة وخمسين.

arabic.title: معادلتان
arabic.narration: لو الزاويتين تلاتة إكس زائد خمسة واتنين إكس زائد خمسة وعشرين، نساويهم فنلاقي إكس بعشرين.

arabic.title: الزاوية المجاورة
arabic.narration: الزاويتين المتجاورتين على خط مستقيم مجموعهم مية وتمانين. لو واحدة مية وتمانية وعشرين، التانية اتنين وخمسين.

arabic.title: عكس النظرية
arabic.narration: لو زاويتين متناظرتين متساويتين، نقدر نستنتج إن المستقيمين متوازيين.

arabic.title: الرسم الدقيق
arabic.narration: هنرسم المستقيمين واي تساوي صفر وواي تساوي أربعة، والقاطع واي تساوي إكس زائد واحد. الزوايا الحادة خمسة وأربعين درجة في التقاطعين.

arabic.title: تحذير مهم
arabic.narration: لو المستقيمين مش متوازيين، مجرد إن الزوايا في نفس الموضع مش معناه إنهم متساويين.
